EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority)PART I : SECTION (I) — GENERALGovernment Notifications

IT is hereby notified that the following Order issued by the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance, by virtue of thepower vested in him under Section 32 read with Section 8 and Section 30 of the Excise Ordinance (Chapter 52), do bythis Order prescribe that the rules cited as the Excise (security features) Rules 2019 published in the Excise NotificationNo. 04/2019 of the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2128/30 dated June 20, 2019, applied for an importer or a licensedmanufacturer of an excisable artricle referred to in Schedule II of the aforesaid Gazette, was passed by Parliament onOctober 23, 2019.
A. R. DESAPRIYA,Secretary (Acting),Ministry of Finance.Ministry of Finance,Colombo 01,30th October, 2019.
